The ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula creates a breathable, long-contact layer that maximises ingredient absorption while skin repairs itself at night. Powered by 20% Black Rice Extract from Northeast India, rich in antioxidants. Suitable for all skin types.

 Pigmentation and stubborn acne marks are among the toughest skin concerns, because breakouts may fade, but the marks often stay behind. Plum's Black Rice & Niacinamide-TXA 10% Night Clarity Jelly Serum combines 7% Niacinamide and 3% Tranexamic Acid to target pigmentation through multiple pathways, helping visibly reduce dark spots, stubborn acne marks, and improve overall skin clarity. Powered by 20% proprietary Black Rice Extract sourced from Northeast India, this antioxidant-rich night serum comes in a first-of-its-kind ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula that forms a breathable, long-contact layer on the skin to help maximise overnight efficacy while your skin is in repair mode.

 Key Benefits

 
 
 Fades dark spots & pigmentation — 7% Niacinamide + 3% TXA work on two separate melanin pathways

 
 ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula — long-contact breathable layer for deeper overnight absorption

 
 20% Black Rice Extract — antioxidant-rich, sourced from Northeast India

 
 Reduces post-acne marks — visibly clearer skin in 4–8 weeks

 
 Suitable for all skin types — gentle enough for sensitive skin

 
 How to Use

 
 Cleanse face thoroughly

 Apply toner if part of your routine

 Take 2–3 drops of the jelly serum and gently press onto face and neck

 Follow with your night moisturiser

 Use every night for best results

 Apply SPF the next morning

 
 FAQs

 What does niacinamide and TXA serum do?

 Niacinamide (7%) controls oil and fades dark spots by blocking melanin transfer. Tranexamic Acid (3%) targets stubborn pigmentation and post-acne marks through a separate pathway. Together they tackle pigmentation from two angles for faster results.

 What is ActiveHold™ Jelly Formula?

 ActiveHold™ is Plum's proprietary jelly texture that forms a breathable, long-contact layer on skin overnight, helping active ingredients absorb deeper while skin is in repair mode.

 Can I use this serum every night?

 Yes. This is a night-only serum designed for daily use. Apply after cleansing and before moisturiser. Always use SPF the next morning.

 How long to see results from niacinamide TXA serum?

 Most users see visible reduction in dark spots and pigmentation within 4 to 8 weeks of consistent nightly use.

 It’s a proprietary ceramide blend that retrains the skin barrier at a molecular level to rebuild, retain moisture, and resist future damage, while staying feather-light on skin. 

 Plum CeraSense™ Milky Toner is a lightweight hydrating toner packed with Ceramides to replenish, restore & rebalance skin. Every spritz of this milky toner deeply moisturizes skin & supports barrier health to lock in hydration for longer. It absorbs quickly with no sticky residue, making it ideal for layering or using on its own.

 This smart blend, powered by Ceramides that rebuild, Peptides that repair, Acai that defends against daily stressors, Prebiotics that balance the microbiome & 1% NMF that floods skin with hydration and gives dry skin exactly what it craves, without the heaviness.

 How to use: Shake well, then spray directly onto cleansed skin from a few inches away. Gently pat in with palms — no need to wipe or use a cotton pad. Follow with CeraSense™ Moisturizing Crème to lock in hydration.

 Milky toner for dry skin as well as dehydrated oily skin — the lightweight, non-sticky formula replenishes moisture without adding excess oil, so it works even if your skin runs oily but feels tight or flaky.

 Is CeraSense Milky Toner good for oily skin? 
Yes. Despite the name, it's not a milk or cream-based toner that sits heavy on skin. It's a lightweight, water-based spray that absorbs instantly with no residue and no added oils — so it hydrates oily and combination skin without making it greasier.

 Will it make my oily skin more oily? 
No. Oily skin that's dehydrated often overproduces oil to compensate for lost moisture. This toner replenishes hydration directly, which can help balance that cycle rather than add to it.

 Can I use it before makeup if I have oily skin? 
Yes — it absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky film, so it layers well under a gel moisturizer or sunscreen without disturbing makeup application.

 Green tea extract — derived from Camellia Sinensis leaves — is one of the most studied botanical ingredients in dermatology. Its active compound, EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate), is a powerful antioxidant that directly inhibits the growth of Cutibacterium acnes, the bacteria responsible for inflammatory acne.  Glycolic acid, an alpha hydroxy acid derived from sugarcane, works on the surface. At low concentrations in a rinse-off formula, it gently breaks the bonds between dead skin cells, encouraging them to shed evenly. This prevents the buildup of dead skin that clogs pores and leads to blackheads and whiteheads. The result over time is smoother, more even-textured skin — not from scrubbing, but from chemistry.

product: Lakmē 9to5 Hya Glam Plump+Shine Clickstick, Hyaluronic acid & ceramides
tags: lip_color;Lipstick-Liners;New Arrivals;New Launches;top_sale_40
description:
"Experience Lakme’s softest gloss stick yet with the Lakme 9to5 HYA Glam Plump + Shine Clickstick, a formula designed to literally melt onto your lips by flawlessly fusing deep, nourishing lip care with the high-shine finish of a gloss. With just one quick click, it delivers cushiony moisture, rich color, and a sleek, glass-like shine that feels every bit as good as it looks. Rather than just sitting on top of your lips, this advanced formula actively works for them to provide eight hours of continuous hydration. 
It is infused with a powerhouse blend of Hyaluronic Acid known for an instant moisture boost and Ceramides known to lock that hydration in, effectively reducing dryness while creating a naturally plumped finish. 
Available in eight wearable shades specifically formulated to complement Indian skin tones, it is easy to find your daily go-to or a bold weekend favourite. The sleek, user-friendly click pen is built to toss into your everyday bag for quick, fuss-free touch-ups whenever your lips need a boost of glow. Just keep in mind that the mechanism is entirely non-retractable, so go easy on the clicks; a single click dispenses exactly 1mm of product, which is all you need for a flawless application, though a brand-new product may require a few extra clicks to prime the product for its very first use.
Treat your lips to the perfect blend of care and shine with this balm + gloss hybrid. Its ultra-creamy texture glides on effortlessly, delivering rich one-stroke colour payoff while Hyaluronic Acid and Ceramides help replenish moisture and support the lip barrier. Available in 8 flattering shades, it keeps lips looking smooth, glossy, and healthy all day."


 
 Step 1: Gently click the base slightly to dispense the desired amount.
Step 2: Please note that it does not retract.
Step 3: Glide the lip color smoothly over lips, starting from the centre and moving outward.

tags: active_product;all_products;bestseller-giftset;changing-seasons;coupon_product;dd;Makeup - Nail Care;Makeup_Nail_Care;nail_color;nails;ONDC;remove4@1499;review_sectionss;sold_outbttn;top_sale_40
description:
"Looking to spice up your nails at home? In that case, Lakmé True Wear Color Crush Nail Color is here to stay and slay! A flawless, salon-like finish in just one coat – get ready for your nails to look glossy and feel as smooth and fresh as ever! Create trendy nail art for all occasions with a resin-based formula that locks in color and lasts longer than usual. That’s not all- our extensive range of 50 vibrant shades cater to all looks, moods, and occasions. Work or play, you can now “nail” every look effortlessly. Most importantly, our nail paint formula is chip resistant. So, even with a quick, at home nail fix, you’ll get the benefits of a professional nail job. All you must do is, start with absolutely clean nails. Place a dot of the nail paint above the cuticle and glide the formula from the centre to the rest of the nail. Continue to sweep from the bottom to the tip of your nails. Use a q-tip and remover to clean edges and apply top-coat to lock color. That’s all you need to do to ace every nail trend with Lakmé True Wear Color Crush Nail Color."

 
 Step 1: Shake well before use. Twist cap and remove the excess product while removing the brush out. Step 2: Place on the center part of the nail just below the cuticle and drag below. Step 3: Repeat process on both sides of the center line ensure no empty spots on the nail. Step 4: Allow the first coat to dry completely before applying the second coat. Step 5: Apply 2 coats as recommended.

"Looking to spice up your nails at home? In that case, Lakmé True Wear Color Crush Nail Color is here to stay and slay! A flawless, salon-like finish in just one coat – get ready for your nails to look glossy and feel as smooth and fresh as ever! Create trendy nail art for all occasions with a resin-based formula that locks in color and lasts longer than usual. That’s not all- our extensive range of 50 vibrant shades cater to all looks, moods, and occasions. Work or play, you can now “nail” every look effortlessly. Most importantly, our nail paint formula is chip resistant. So, even with a quick, at home nail fix, you’ll get the benefits of a professional nail job. All you must do is, start with absolutely clean nails. Place a dot of the nail paint above the cuticle and glide the formula from the centre to the rest of the nail. Continue to sweep from the bottom to the tip of your nails. Use a q-tip and remover to clean edges and apply top-coat to lock color. That’s all you need to do to ace every nail trend with Lakmé True Wear Color Crush Nail Color."

 
 Step 1: Shake well before use. Twist cap and remove the excess product while removing the brush out. Step 2: Place on the center part of the nail just below the cuticle and drag below. Step 3: Repeat process on both sides of the center line ensure no empty spots on the nail. Step 4: Allow the first coat to dry completely before applying the second coat. Step 5: Apply 2 coats as recommended.

boAt Storm Call - Bluetooth Calling Smart Watch with 1.69" (4.29 cm) HD display 

 Pick. Dial. Connect. Do it all from your wrist with our all-new bluetooth calling smartwatch – boAt Storm Call! Dial right from your wrist & experience seamless Bluetooth calling. You can also save up to 10 contacts and explore your world with its 1.69” HD Display smartwatch. Connections are for everybody with boAt Storm Call.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Call with Convenience 

 Featuring a super responsive dial pad, boAt Storm Call not only lets you connect seamlessly via BT Calling but also allows you to save up to 10 contacts. Experience loud and clear calls with its in-built speaker.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Big Screen. Better Display 

 Get a maximized view of your world with its 1.69” HD Display. This calling smartwatch comes with a 2.5D Curved Display that produces an immersive touch experience. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Sleek and Stylish 

 With just 45gms of weight, this smartwatch is made for long hours of wearing without discomfort. The silicone strap will compliment your look without compromising on durability and comfort.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Enhanced and Sharper Colour Resolution 

 Make your world come alive with its sharp display that is packed with 550 nits of brightness and a high-resolution colour screen with a 70% RGB colour gamut. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Guided Breathing 

 Guide yourself to mindfulness with breath awareness and help lower your heart rate to normal. De-stress yourself and keep your mind at peace effortlessly with this calling smartwatch.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Prioritize Your Wellbeing 

 Manage all your health data and vitals anywhere, anytime with SpO2, sleep, calories, and heart rate monitors. Make health your priority with the boAt Storm Call.

 FAQs

 
 
 Q. Does Storm call come with different watch faces?

 Q. Does it come with support for GPS?

 Q. Does it come with Media controls?

 Yes, all of our smartwatches come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

boAt Rockerz 551ANC - Premium Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphone

 Rockerz 551ANC is all set to rock your world! With Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation up to 35dB, experience uninterrupted and immersive sound. Enjoy a total playback of 100 Hours and feel the thumping beats with its 40mm drivers. Make every music sesh feel like a concert with Rockerz 551ANC.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Focus on What Matters

 These wireless headphones feature Active Noise Cancellation which cancels out background noise with ease. And when you want to unmute the world, turn the Ambient Mode on.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thumping Bass, Punching Sound

 If music gives you energy then the 40mm drivers thumping boAt Signature Sound will keep you pumped every single day! Whether beats or blues, these headphones feature bass that is tuned for a thumping listening experience.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Never Stop Listening

 And how could you? Rockerz 551ANC gives you a massive 100 Hours playback in a single charge! What’s more? Get 10 Hours of juice with just 10 Minutes of charging! See? Faster than Flash.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Who Likes Disturbances?

 Imagine having an important call which starts & ends with “hello?...hell–ooo?” This won’t be your fear with Rockerz 551ANC. These headphones are engineered with ENx™ Technology that makes your call smooth & clear, eliminating disturbances!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Choose The Mode For Your Mood

 Rockerz 551ANC is integrated with custom-tuned EQ Modes for elevated audio immersion. Now choose from the 2 EQ Modes: Signature & Balanced to experience full-spectrum sound.

 FAQs

 
 
 Q. How can we pause and play tracks? 

 Rockerz 551ANC Wireless Bluetooth earphones come with a host of intuitive features including the Quick Switch Button that allows the user to switch between two devices by just double tapping. This gives you full seamless control over music and other media. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features. 
 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on boAt Rockerz 551ANC Wireless earphones? 

 Yes, a single press on the multi-function button allows the user to easily accept and reject calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can I use any adapter to charge my device? 

 Yes, you can use any adapter to charge your Rockerz 551 ANC 
 
 
 Q. How long does boAt Rockerz 551ANC last on a single charge? 

 Rockerz 551ANC offers a battery backup of up to 150 hours on a single charge. 
 
 
 Q. Does it support Fast Charging? 

 Rockerz 551ANC supports ASAP Fast charging. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones with a mobile charger? 

 A. Yes, Rockerz 551ANC supports Type-C charging. If your mobile charger comes with Type-C charging support then you can easily use the same to charge your device. 
 
 
 Q. Is it good for office use and for calls, meetings, media consumption etc.? 

 Yes, Rockerz 551ANC is perfect for a variety of uses. It can be used for calls, meetings making it perfect for Zoom, Meet, Teams etc. 
 
 
 Q. Are they compatible with iPhones and Android phones? 

 Yes, Rockerz 551ANC is fully compatible with iPhones and Android devices. 
 
 
 Q. How can I connect with Google and Siri? 

 Rockerz 551ANC comes with a ‘single-press’ voice assistant to connect with your voice assistant. Please refer to the manual for further instructions. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty? 

 Yes, all of our headphones come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

boAt Lunar Connect Ace - Round AMOLED Display Smartwatch with Bluetooth Calling
 
 
 Experience excellence with boAt Lunar Connect Ace smartwatch. Its 1.43" AMOLED Display delivers crystal-clear clarity and vibrant colors so you don’t miss any details. Stay connected with Bluetooth calling and save up to 10 contacts for quick dialing. Choose your style with metal mesh, leather, or silicone strap options as you add the edge by changing the watch face everyday from the 100+ options. Packed with 100+ sports modes, heart rate, SpO2, and sleep monitors, it helps you train like an ace and keep a track of your health on the go. With Lunar Connect Ace, stay informed and empowered as you unleash your potential.


 
 
 
 
 
 
 Crystal Clear Clarity 

 
 Experience excellence with 1.43” AMOLED Display that gets you unmatched clarity and rich colour output. Choose to keep it on Always On Display never miss any detail with its 700 Nits brightness.


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Connect As You Go

 Save up to 10 contacts on your watch and talk to them with Bluetooth Calling using the built-in mics. With a touch responsive dial pad, you can dial the number you want and talk as you go on our BT calling smart watch.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Choose Your Style

 Select from options of a metal mesh, leather and silicone strap to go with your personality. To add another dimension to your style, there are also 100+ watch faces to choose from.


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Train With Ace

 Ace your fitness with boAt Lunar Connect Ace. Be it indoor or outdoor activity, it has all the modes you need. Choose from a set of 100+ sports modes and get going on whatever sport you play. For a complete health experience, our smart watch also has heart rate, SpO2 and sleep monitoring as well as guided breathing and menstrual tracking. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 IP68 Rating

 Go wherever you want, designed to join you on all your escapades the IP68 rated boAt Lunar Connect Ace can take it all with its Dust, Sweat & Water Resistance.


 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 The World on Your Wrist

 View all your notifications and alerts on your wrist. Alerts to drink water or alerts from your phone get them all on your smart watch. With daily activity trackers, know how much you walked, calorie spent and alerts if you’ve been sitting for long.

 Let Nothing Disturb Your Vibe 



 Immerse yourself in a world of tranquility with Airdopes 141 ANC's cutting-edge Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) technology, silencing distractions by up to 32dB. Enjoy every beat with great clarity, undisturbed by the outside world.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 There’s No Stopping 

 Immerse in your playlists for every mood with Airdopes 141 ANC, providing an non-stop 42 Hours of uninterrupted playback. Stay tuned in without missing a beat, all day and all night.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Switch According To The Tracks 

 Airdopes 141 ANC offers Dual EQ Modes: Signature for deep bass and Balanced for crystal-clear tones. Customize your sound, elevate your experience.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The Game Is On 

 Plug into an expertly tuned lag-free audio experience with BEAST™️ Mode giving 50 ms of low latency, designed to level up all your streaming and gaming sessions.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 You Can’t Be Clearer Than This

 FAQs

 
 
 Q. How long does Airdopes 141ANC last on a single charge? 

 boAt Airdopes 141ANC wireless earbuds offer battery backup of up to 42 hours on a single charge.

 Yes, Airdopes 141ANC does support Active Noise Cancellation. With up to 32dB ANC, enjoy your playlist uninterrupted.

 Yes, these wireless earbuds come with Quad mics with ENx™️ Technology, ensuring crystal-clear calls for an enhanced talking experience.

 Yes, all of our true wireless earbuds come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

description:
Rockerz 450 Pro Wireless Headphone 

 It’s time to rock your lives with Rockerz 450 Pro. Get astounded and feel every beat with these bluetooth headphones that are here to make music more fun. With 40mm drivers and the unbeatable boAt Signature sound, groove to your favourite music. Make work and workouts more fun with a mountainous playback time of 70 hours that never gives up on you. With charging just for 10 minutes, enjoy music and your binge sessions non stop for 10 hours!  It is time for you to get fresh on fashion and high on comfort with Rockerz 450 Pro. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 40mm Drivers: boAt Signature Audio 

 With 40mm drivers experience the boAt’s Signature audio like never before! Feel the beats running through your soul and experience bass that teleports you to another world. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Never Run Out Of Good Moves 

 Now with a playback of upto 70 hours make sure you are dancing for the win! Binge on your favorite series without any interruption for these rockerz aren’t going to run out of battery.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Unbelievable Performance 

 Powered by ASAP charge that never lets you down. With just 10 minutes of charge, get 10 hours of performance! 

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Specifications 

 Connect & Play

 
 
 
 
 Headphone Type 
 On-Ear Headphones 
 
 
 Driver Type 
 Moving Coil Driver 
 
 
 Driver Size 
 40 mm 
 
 
 Impedance 
 32Ω 
 
 
 Sensitivity (dB) 
 -80db<+/-0.1% 
 
 
 Frequency Response 
 2.4GHz-2.480GHz 
 
 
 Battery Capacity (mAh) 
 750 mAh with Protection Board 
 
 
 Playback Time 
 upto 70 hours (at 60% volume) 
 
 
 Charging Time 
 2-3 hours 
 
 
 Standby Time 
 500-600 hours 
 
 
 Bluetooth Version 
 V5.0 
 
 
 Country Of Origin 
 China 
 
 
 Compatibility 
 All Bluetooth Devices 
 
 
 Bluetooth Range 
 10M 
 
 
 
 
 
 


 
 



 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Extra Connectivity, Extra Fun 

 If you cannot decide to go wireless or stay wired, do not worry. With Bluetooth v5.0 you can go wireless or wire yourself up with AUX! 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 
 
 
 
 FAQ

 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on it? Is it good for calls, meetings and work from home?

 Rockerz 450 Pro is designed for great clarity and comfort during meetings and important calls. Single press on the multi-function button to easily accept and reject calls. 
 
 
 Q. How is the battery life of the device?

 Rockerz 450 Pro can last for 70 hours when used at 60% volume. 
 
 
 Q. Is it good for running and sports in general?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 Pro on-ear headphones have IPX7 dust and water resistance making it perfect for sports and adventures. 
 
 
 Q. Does it have a dedicated microphone? What interface does it support?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 Pro headphones have a dedicated mic perfect for calls and recording. One can charge their devices with any Type-C charger. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my headphones with a mobile charger?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 Pro wireless headphones can be charged with a mobile charger. 
 
 
 Q. How long does it take to charge? Does it support fast charging?

 Rockerz 450 Pro takes 2-3 hours to charge. It supports ASAP fast charging, one can get 10H of playback with only 10 minutes of charge. 
 
 
 Q. Can we use it while putting the headphones on charge?

 Yes, one can use the device while charging it at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What bluetooth version does Rockerz 450 Pro support?

 Rockerz 450 Pro wireless bluetooth headphones supports Bluetooth v5.0. It also comes with dual connectivity, users can connect via AUX as well as Bluetooth. 
 
 
 Q. What can I do with the inline buttons?

 You can change tracks, adjust volume, take and reject calls, redial, and access voice assistant with the inline buttons. For further information, please refer to the user manual. 
 
 
 Q. How can I enable Google and Siri?

 Double tap to connect with Google & Siri and activate the voice assistant. Please refer to the manual for further instructions. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warrant

description:
boAt Airdopes 161 - Wireless Earbuds

 Your partner for every vibe, Airdopes 161 earbuds pumps uninterrupted music with its massive playback of upto 40 Hours. And when you run out of battery, you can enjoy 180 Minutes of music with just 10 Minutes of charge. Grooving has never been so hasslefree with Bluetooth v5.1 that seamlessly plays your music. Gone are the days when you had to check if your device is connected or not. Our. connects with your paired devices as soon as you open the lid of the case. Indulge in our immersive sound with its 10mm driver and enjoy music for every vibe.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 AIRDOPES 161

 Charge for 10 Minutes, ENJOY 180 Minutes

  

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 IPX5 WATER & SWEAT RESISTANCE

 Ace your sport. You don’t have to worry about your Airdopes as you groove to your favourite workout tracks.

  

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 boAt Immersive Sound

 Get captivated by boAt immersive sound powered by 13mm drivers no matter what you are playing. The bass is tuned for a thumping listening experience that transports you to another world.

  

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Type C Interface

 Type C interface promises — speed, ease of use, versatility. Say goodbye to your charging struggles.

  

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Quick Response Touch Controls

 Control your music with ease. Play/pause, attend calls and activate voice assistants via just a touch.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 
 
 
 
 FAQs

 
 
 Q. How can we pause and play tracks? 

 Airdopes 161 comes with a host of intuitive features that allow one to seamlessly control music. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features. 
 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on boAt Airdopes 161? 

 Yes, one can easily accept and reject calls on Airdopes 161. It comes with Quick Response Touch Controls that allows you to easily accept and reject calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can I use any adapter to charge my device? 

 Yes, you can use any adapter to charge your Airdopes 161 charging case. 
 
 
 Q. How long does boAt Airdopes 161 last on a single charge? 

 Airdopes 161 wireless earbuds offer upto 40 Hours of backup. 
 
 
 Q. How long does it take to charge? 

 Airdopes 161 takes around 1.5-2 hrs to charge fully. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones while the case is being charged? 

 Yes, one can simultaneously charge the carrying case and the bluetooth earbuds at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What is the use of the charging case? How long does it take the charging case to charge? 

 The charging case is ergonomically designed to be portable and lightweight. You can carry your in-ear earbuds around while they’re being charged in the case. The charging case takes around 1.5-2 hours to charge. 
 
 
 Q. Are they compatible with iPhones and Android phones? 

 Yes, Airdopes 161 is fully compatible with iPhones and Android devices. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty? 

 Yes, all of our true wireless earbuds come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

 FAQs

 Yes, one can simultaneously

Party Pal 300 - Bluetooth Party Speaker with Mic 

 Party Pal 300 is not just a speaker; it's your "pal" that knows how to turn any gathering into an unforgettable celebration.  Immersive Sound Experience 

 
 With 120W Boat Signature Sound, your music isn't just played; it's celebrated. It is designed to transport you to a world of audio excellence and ensure that every instrument, vocal, and beat is reproduced with astonishing clarity. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 6 Hours of Non-Stop Fun 

 
 The party doesn't have a curfew, and neither does Party Pal 300! With an incredible 6 hours of playback, dance the night away without a worry in the world.
 

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Bass & Treble at Your Fingertips 

 
 Customize your sound experience with adjustable bass and treble settings. Perfectly tune the music to suit your mood and genre.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Double The Excitement 

 
 Take your party to a whole new dimension with Party Pal 300's TWS feature. The Truly Wireless Stereo mode allows you to pair two speakers for a stereo experience that fills the room with 2x the power.
 

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Be The Favorite Host! 

 
 Party Pal 300 makes it effortless to be everyone's favorite host, especially during karaoke nights. Its mic output allows you to easily connect a microphone and let your vocal talents shine, and the dedicated guitar output lets you plug in your electric guitar and jam along to your favorite tunes. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hassle-free & Convenient 

 
 With its multi-device compatibility and convenient Type C connectivity, Party Pal 300 ensures hassle-free and easy pairing with all your devices, allowing you to take full control with the master remote.

 Party Pal 300 Bluetooth speakers come with a host of intuitive features and easy access buttons that gives full seamless control over music and other media. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features.

 Yes, you can use any adapter to charge your Party Pal 300.

 Party Pal 300 wireless speakers offer battery backup of up to 6 hours.

 Yes, Party Pal 300 comes with AUX, USB, Bluetooth 5.3, TF card.

boAt Airdopes Ace - True Wireless Earbuds with Long Battery Life 

 Ace your calls, upgrade your music, and conquer every activity with Airdopes Ace - where performance meets the 'ace' of sound! Featuring powerful 13mm drivers and boAt Signature Sound, these earbuds deliver a music experience like no other. The 35 Hours of total playtime ensures your soundtrack lasts as long as your day. Enjoy crystal-clear call quality with ENx™ Technology and make the most of every moment with Airdopes Ace!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Never Miss a Beat 



 Feel the power of music like never before with Airdopes Ace. Equipped with BEAST™ Mode for ultra-low latency, and boasting massive 13 mm drivers, these earbuds deliver heart-thumping bass, crystal-clear highs, and everything in between.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ‘Ace’ Your Daily Soundtrack 

 It provides an impressive 35 Hours of total playtime, ensuring you're always ready to groove. It also comes equipped with the ASAP™ Charge feature. Need a quick power boost to keep the music going? No problem. Just a speedy 10 Minutes charge gives you up to 120 Minutes of playback time.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Make Your Calls Stand Out 

 Ace your conversations with Airdopes Ace's Dual Microphones featuring ENx™ Technology. This ground-breaking innovation ensures crystal-clear call quality even in noisy environments. Be it a bustling street or a crowded café, your voice will come through loud and clear.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Discover The Adventurer In You 

 No need to fret about sweat, rain, or splashes ruining your earbuds. Airdopes Ace boasts an IPX5 water-resistant rating, making them the perfect companions for workouts, outdoor adventures, or simply staying active while you enjoy your favourite tunes.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Enjoy Hassle-Free Connectivity 

 Experience instant and hassle-free connectivity with Airdopes Ace, thanks to IWP™ Technology. Just open the case, and they're ready to pair with your device, ensuring you never miss a beat!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Convenience at its Best 

 We've made sure Airdopes Ace is not just a sound powerhouse but also incredibly convenient. Their pocketable design ensures they're always ready to go wherever life takes you. Plus, the intuitive touch controls make it a breeze to adjust volume, skip tracks, or answer calls with a simple tap, and with the one-touch voice assistant feature, you have your very own digital assistant at your beck and call.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
  

 
  

 
  

 
 
 
 
 FAQs

 
 
 Q. Are Airdopes Ace waterproof and sweat resistant? 

 Yes, Airdopes Ace is IPX5 Water and Sweat Resistant. You can use it for your workouts or carry them along on long trips. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my wireless earbuds with a mobile charger? 

 Yes, Airdopes Ace supports Type-C charging ports. If your mobile charger comes with a Type-C charging port, then you can easily use the same to charge your device. 
 
 
 Q. How long does boAt Airdopes Ace last on a single charge? 

 Airdopes Ace wireless earbuds offer a total battery backup of up to 35 hours. It also supports ASAP™ Charge that yields a playtime of 120 minutes with only 10 minutes of charging time. 
 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on boAt Airdopes Ace? 

 Yes, Airdopes Ace allows you to accept calls on a tap. It comes with Dual Mics featuring ENx™ Technology that suppresses background noise when speaking into the mic which allows for an unrivaled calling experience. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim the warranty? 

 Yes, all of our Airdopes come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

Immortal 170 - Bluetooth Gaming Earbuds for Gamers 

 Be immortal in the world of virtual battles powered by Immortal 170! Specially crafted for gamers, these gaming earphones boast cutting-edge BEAST™ Mode, which delivers sound almost instantaneously so that you can respond to the audio in the game better and quicker. Immersive gaming sessions demand endurance, and Immortal 170 delivers with an impressive 40 Hour playback, and the ASAP™ Technology pumps another 3 hours of juice within 10 Minutes of charge. Always bring your A-game, level up with boAt!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Call Disturbances Not Found 



 ENx™ Technology suppresses unwanted background noise while on calls and BEAST™ mode delivers 40ms super low latency audio which ensures there’s no audio lag. The boAt Signature Sound makes the beats come alive to give you an unmatched experience.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Never Run Out Of Juice 

 Enjoy uninterrupted play with 40 Hours of playback on a single charge. Should the need arise, a mere 10 Minutes recharge through our revolutionary ASAP™️ Charge empowers you to conquer the next 180 Minutes of gaming supremacy with our gaming earbuds!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Effortless and Quick 

 With Bluetooth v5.3, Immortal 170 allows seamless connectivity and our innovative IWP™ Technology takes it a step further, instantly pairing with your device the moment the your wireless earbuds come out of the charging case.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Get In The Right Vibe 

 Immerse yourself in the perfect gaming vibe with the blazing RGB lights of boAt Immortal 170. Increase your style quotient as the luminous lights truly set you and your Immortal 170 apart.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Go Beyond Boundaries 

 Immortal 170 takes your musical journey to new horizons. It comes equipped with IPX4 Water Resistance, allowing you to take your music wherever you go without boundaries.

 
 
 
 
 









 

 



 
 
 
 
 FAQs

 
 
 Q. How can we pause and play tracks? 

 Single tap the capacitive touch control on either earbud to play a song or to pause one. Immortal 170 comes with a host of intuitive features that allow one to seamlessly control music. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features. 
 
 
 Q. Are Immortal 170 waterproof and sweat resistant? 

 Yes, Immortal 170 is IPX4 water and sweat resistant. You can use it for your workouts or carry them along on long trips. 
 
 
 Q. How long does boAt Immortal 170 last on a single charge? 

 Immortal 170 wireless earbuds offer a total battery backup of up to 40 hours. It also supports ASAP™ Charge that yields a playtime of 180 mins with only 10 minutes of charging time. 
 
 
 Q. Can Immortal 170 be used for casual gaming? 

 Yes, you can use Immortal 170 for casual gaming on your phone. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones with a mobile charger? 

 Yes, Immortal 170 supports Type-C charging. If your mobile charger comes with Type-C charging support then you can easily use the same to charge your device. 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty? 

 Yes, all of our true wireless earbuds come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

 Meet Rockerz 185 Pro — The wireless earbuds, engineered with ENx™ Technology for exceptional call clarity. Switch to BEAST™ Mode for low latency and immerse yourself in your favourite music. Plus, with dual pairing, you can connect two devices at the same time. Upgrade to Rockerz 185 Pro for an unmatched audio experience. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Turn Your BEAST Mode On 

 Experience smooth and uninterrupted audio with Rockerz 185 Pro's BEAST™ Mode, delivering a low latency of just 40ms for an ultra-fast and seamless connection. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Calls Have Never Been Clearer 

 Rockerz 185 Pro's exclusive ENx™ Technology ensures crystal clear calls by reducing background noise and enhancing voice clarity. Enjoy uninterrupted conversations even in noisy environments.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Stay Charged For The Day 

 Elevate your music game as our neckband features ASAP™ Charge. Charge for just 10 minutes and get 10 hours of playback time. Not only this, Rockerz 185 Pro features a long playback of 20HRS. Never miss a beat again, no matter where your day takes you.

 Protect And Fortify 

 With such high-tech features in a device, it needs protection. Rockerz 185 Pro comes with an IPX4 water resistance rating that ensures it keeps water and sweat out no matter the odds. Keep ballin’ without worry with Rockerz 185 Pro. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FAQ

 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on it? Is it good for calls, meetings and work from home?

 Yes, a single press on the multi-function button allows the user to easily accept and reject calls. Rockerz 185 Pro are designed for great clarity and comfort during meetings and important calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can we adjust the length of the wire?

 No, the length of the wire cannot be adjusted. 
 
 
 Q. Does it have a dedicated microphone?

 Yes, Rockerz 185 Pro earphones has a dedicated mic perfect for calls and recording. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones with a mobile charger?

 Yes, Rockerz 185 Pro earphones can be charged with a mobile charger. 
 
 
 Q. How long does it take to charge? Does it support fast charging?

 Rockerz 185 Pro takes around 2H to charge. It does supports fast charging 
 
 
 Q. Can we use it while putting the earphones on charge?

 Yes, one can use the device while charging it at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What bluetooth version does Rockerz 185 Pro support?

 Rockerz 185 Pro Bluetooth earphones supports Bluetooth v5.3.

 You can change tracks, adjust volume, take and reject calls, redial, and access voice assistant with the inline buttons. For further information, please refer to the user manual.

 Double tap to connect with Google & Siri and activate the voice assistant. Please refer to the manual for further instructions.

 Yes, all of our wireless earphones & headphones come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

 Let the noise of the world drown as you jam to your rhythm with Airdopes 148. Equipped with 8mm drivers, these dope wireless earbuds make your playlist sound better with crystal clear audio quality and powerful bass. Experience seamless calling and be clearly heard with ENxTM Technology. That is not all,  ASAPTM Charge technology empowers you with 75 minutes of playback with just 5 minutes of charging. With IPX4 Sweat and Water Resistance, there's no stopping you from listening to your workout mix while breaking a sweat. Moreover, its IWP TM Technology and Quick Response Touch Controls ensure you can answer calls and switch music without interrupting your flow. Go ahead, your perfect audio match is right here. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 boAtheads, get ready for the most insane Truly Wireless experience ever with ENx TM    Technology. 

  

 Airdopes 148 

   

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 boAt Signature Sound : 8mm drivers 

 Fall in love with music, again, with boAt Signature Sound and dynamic 8mm drivers. 

  

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Insta Wake 'n' Pair Technology 

 Connect your device to these dope earbuds effortlessly with Insta Wake and Pair Technology. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 IPX4 Sweat And Water Resistance 

 Don't shy away from breaking a sweat as it's built to endure everything your hustle demands.  

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Quick Response Touch Controls 

 The Quick Response Touch Controls ensure a seamless experience of navigating between different controls. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FAQ

 
 
 Q. How can we pause and play tracks?

 Airdopes 148 comes with a host of intuitive features that allow one to seamlessly control music. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features. 
 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on boAt Airdopes 148?

 Yes, one can easily accept and reject calls on Airdopes 148. It comes with Quick Response Touch Controls that allows you to easily accept and reject calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can I use any adapter to charge my device?

 Yes, you can use any adapter to charge your Airdopes 148 charging case. 
 
 
 Q. How long does boAt Airdopes 148 last on a single charge?

 Airdopes 148 wireless earbuds offer upto 42 hours of backup. 
 
 
 Q. How long does it take to charge?

 Airdopes 141 takes around 45 minutes to charge fully. ASAP charge lets you enjoy 75 minutes of playback with just 5 minutes of charge. 
 
 
 Q. Does it support fast charging?

 Yes, Airdopes 148 comes with ASAP charge technology. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones while the case is being charged?

 Yes, one can simultaneously charge the carrying case and the bluetooth earbuds at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What is the use of the charging case? How long does it take the charging case to charge?

 The charging case is ergonomically designed to be portable and lightweight. You can carry your in-ear earbuds around while they’re being charged in the case. The charging case takes around 1.5-2 hours to charge. 
 
 
 Q. Are they compatible with iPhones and Android phones?

 Yes, Airdopes 148 is fully compatible with iPhones and Android devices. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty?

 Yes, all of our true wireless earbuds come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

 There is no better justice to your playlist & binging than Rockerz 450 boAt | DC edition. If low battery is your enemy, the 15HRS non-stop playback is here to rightfully combat that. Feel the power rising up in your veins as you indulge in your playlist with its 40mm dynamic drivers. Make adaptiveness your superpower just like the adaptive headband of Rockerz 450. Get ready to rule with #DCYou. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Power Up For 15HRS 

 Power up your hustle as you become the hero you envision to be with 15HRS playback at your service. Rockerz 450 won’t stop until you do. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 HD Immersive Audio 

 The 40mm drivers will make you charge up as you immerse yourself in your playlist. The boAt Signature Sound will shine through, no matter what. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Adaptive Ear Cups and Headband

 FAQs

 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on it? Is it good for calls, meetings and work from home?

 Yes, a single press on the multi-function button allows the user to easily accept and reject calls. Rockerz 450 are designed for great clarity and comfort during meetings and important calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can we adjust the length of the wire?

 No, the length of the wire cannot be adjusted. 
 
 
 Q. Does it have a dedicated microphone?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 headphones has a dedicated mic perfect for calls and recording. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my headphones with a mobile charger?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 wireless headphones can be charged with a mobile charger. 
 
 
 Q. How long does it take to charge? Does it support fast charging?

 Rockerz 450 takes 3H to charge. It does not support fast charging. 
 
 
 Q. Can we use it while putting the headphones on charge?

 Yes, one can use the device while charging it at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What bluetooth version does Rockerz 450 support?

 Rockerz 450 wireless Bluetooth headphones supports Bluetooth v4.2. 
 
 
 Q. What can I do with the inline buttons?

 You can change tracks, adjust volume, take and reject calls, redial, and access voice assistant with the inline buttons. For further information, please refer to the user manual. 
 
 
 Q. Does it have AUX support?

 Yes, Rockerz 450 also has AUX support when bluetooth is not in use. 
 
 
 Q. How can I enable Google and Siri?

 Double tap to connect with Google & Siri and activate the voice assistant. Please refer to the manual for further instructions. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty?

 Yes, all of our wireless earphones & headphones come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

Airdopes 131 DC Edition - True Wireless Earbuds 

 Sleek. Comfortable. Stylish. And a splash of amazing acoustic powers. Airdopes 131 true wireless earbuds are equipped with 13mm drivers that offer you beyond the ordinary sound. Keep going on for long like the DC heroes with its 12 hours of capacity. Plug-in be prepared to be awe struck. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Super Connectivity 

 Experience a super and instant connection with Bluetooth v5.0 and Insta Wake n Pair. With Type-C port get your device charged at speeds that break barriers. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 13 mm Drivers 

 Immerse in an other worldly experience with boAt Signature Sound delivered via the powerful 13mm drivers. Groove to your list as you find the hero in you. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Feels Like You Can Fly 

 Carry Airdopes 131 around with ease. Its ergonomic fit doesn’t give even the slightest discomfort when you wear it for long. By being lightweight it's so easy to carry around, it's almost like you are flying like your favourite heroes. 

   

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FAQs

 
 
 
 Q. How can we pause and play tracks?

 Single tap the capacitive touch control on either earbud to play a song or to pause one. Airdopes 131 comes with a host of intuitive features that allows one to seamlessly control music. Please refer to the instruction manual to learn about the different ways one can take advantage of its features. 
 
 
 Q. Can we accept calls on boAt Airdopes 131?

 Yes, one can easily accept and reject calls on Airdopes 131. A single press on the multi-function button allows the user to easily accept and reject calls. 
 
 
 Q. Can I use any adapter to charge my device?

 Yes, you can use any adapter to charge your Airdopes 131 Charging case. 
 
 
 Q. Are Airdopes 131 waterproof and sweat resistant?

 NO, Airdopes 131 does not come with dust & water resistance. 
 
 
 Q. How long does Airdopes 131 last on a single charge?

 Airdopes 131 wireless earbuds offer battery backup of up to 3 hours on a single charge. They also give a total playback time of 12 hours along with the charging case. 
 
 
 Q. What is the battery capacity of Airdopes 131 and how long does it take to charge?

 The battery capacity of Airdopes 131 is 40mAh for each earbud and the charging case has a battery capacity of 650mAh. The earbuds take around 1.5H to fully charge. 
 
 
 Q. Does it support fast charging?

 No, Airdopes 131 supports only standard charging. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones with a mobile charger?

 Yes, Airdopes 131 supports Type-C charging. If your mobile charger comes with Type-C charging support then you can easily charge your device using your mobile charger. 
 
 
 Q. Can I charge my earphones while the case is being charged?

 Yes, one can simultaneously charge the carrying case and the bluetooth earbuds at the same time. 
 
 
 Q. What is the use of the charging case? How long does it take the charging case to charge?

 The charging case is ergonomically designed to be portable and lightweight. You can carry your in-ear earbuds around while they’re being charged in the case. The charging case takes around 1.5-2 hours to charge. 
 
 
 Q. What Bluetooth version do boAt Airdopes 131 support?

 Airdopes 131 earbuds come with Bluetooth v5.0 technology. These in ear earbuds also support all previous versions of Bluetooth. 
 
 
 Q. Are they compatible with iPhones and Android phones?

 Yes, Airdopes 131 are fully compatible with iPhones and Android devices. 
 
 
 Q. How do I reboot/restart my earbuds?

 In order to reboot your device, turn off Bluetooth on your mobile device, place your earbuds in the case, close the lid, and wait for 10 seconds. 
 
 
 Q. How do I factory reset my earbud?

 In order to factory reset your Airdopes 131, go to the Bluetooth settings on your mobile device, find your Airdopes 131 and select 'forget'.
 On your Airdopes 131,

 Step 1: Keep both the earbuds inside the case in their correct orientation

 Step 2: Triple tap the MFB on both

boAt BassHeads 104

A carefully crafted half in-ear design with casual elegance in abundance, choose your colour that sets your vibe and begin the journey! Connect easily to all types of devices via its 3.5mm jack.  Immersive Audio 

 For all the audio lovers out there! The Bassheads 104 carries pure music reproduction techniques via 10mm drivers that make you step with style and live within the beat, Get Hooked.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lightweight Secure Fit Design 

 The Bassheads 104 looks cool, fiery, and deadly depending on which color you choose! With a secure fit and a design that brings out the best in you, it is time to define fashion your way.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 An Absolute Experience

 Hands-free communication In-line mic 

 That turns around all sound as you handle your business with simple finesse as you are able to take calls and and let nothing get in your way.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FAQs

 Yes, BassHeads 104 comes with an in-line microphone. The microphone also features in-built noise isolation technology.

 Yes, BassHeads 104 comes with passive noise cancellation. 
 
 
 Q. What is the length of the cable? 

 The cable is 1200mm long. 
 
 
 Q. Is there a warranty for the product? How do I claim warranty? 

 Yes, all of our earphones come with a 1 year warranty. To register your device, visit https://support.boat-lifestyle.com/.

description:
Experience music without isolation with the Noise Air Clips OWS Open Ear Wireless Earbuds – featuring a distinctive chrome finish and open-ear design that keeps you aware of your surroundings while enjoying premium sound.

 Key Features:

 • Open Ear Design (OWS) – Stay aware of your surroundings while enjoying music, perfect for outdoor activities and safety  

 • Chrome Finish – Sleek, stylish metallic design that stands out  

 • 12mm Premium Drivers – Powerful audio with Tru Bass™ technology for rich, deep sound  

 • 40 Hours Total Playtime – Extended battery life for all-day listening  

 • IPX4 Water Resistance – Sweat and splash-resistant for workouts, running, and outdoor adventures  

 • Secure Ear Clip Design – Comfortable, stable fit that stays in place during activity  

 • Ultra-Lightweight – Just 5.4 grams per earbud for all-day comfort  

 • Full Touch Controls – Easy music and call management with intuitive gestures  

 • Dedicated Mics – Individual microphones in each earbud for clear calls  

 • Hyper Sync™ Technology – Fast and stable Bluetooth 5.0 connection  

 • Type-C Charging – Quick and convenient charging  

 • 3 Elegant Colors – Pearl Black, Pearl White, Pearl Purple  

 Perfect For:

 Runners, cyclists, commuters, and outdoor enthusiasts who need situational awareness while enjoying their music. Ideal for anyone who finds traditional in-ear earbuds uncomfortable.

 Safe Listening:

 The open-ear design lets you hear traffic, conversations, and your environment while staying entertained.

 Style meets safety with premium sound.
